description: Updates one order of a physical product: its status (paid → shipped → delivered, or returned) and its carrier and tracking. shipped needs a carrier or a tracking number; one step back fixes a slip. Each new status is sent to the buyer's inbox. returned only records the return: it refunds nothing (neblla_sales; find the sale in neblla_sales_read by buyer and product). Reading orders: neblla_orders_read. More: neblla_get_llms tools/orders

action.description: Always "update". By action: update {orderId, status?, carrier?, tracking?, trackingUrl?}

appId.description: The app's public ID, from neblla_list_apps.

env.description: "pro" (the published app, default) or "pre" (the private test copy).

tracking.description: The tracking number; null clears it.

trackingUrl.description: An https:// link to follow the parcel; null clears it.

name: neblla_orders
title: Update a shipping order
